WITH matched_by_side AS (
  SELECT 
    o.dealedge,
    COUNT(*) as count_per_side
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
average_per_side AS (
  SELECT AVG(count_per_side) as overall_average
  FROM matched_by_side
),
above_average_sides AS (
  SELECT 
    m.count_per_side,
    a.overall_average,
    m.count_per_side - a.overall_average as excess
  FROM matched_by_side m
  CROSS JOIN average_per_side a
  WHERE m.count_per_side > a.overall_average
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count_per_side) as total_count,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM above_average_sides
